unknown_register.requirement: Time from the first sign-up screen to the first create attempt (signup_to_active_account_s).
unknown_register.would_be_established_by: Run counter step 1 with a fresh email on at least the shortlisted shops and set the bound from the measured distribution. No source sets a signup-to-seat bound; the review corpus supplies only the anti-pattern (over a month at GMI, a 3-month wait at Mithril).

unknown_register.requirement: Peak sustainable accepted rate at the latency gates on a seat.
unknown_register.would_be_established_by: Run the PREREG calibration on each arm: continuous backlog, at most 256 outstanding requests, up to five minutes after readiness; capacity C is valid only if throughput was stable. Run 3 offered 8,622 requests in 3,600 s (2.395 req/s average, peak 531 arrivals in one minute) with 0 transport failures on A/T0 and N/T0, so capacity is above that but unmeasured.

unknown_register.requirement: p99 TTFT ceiling for burst traffic.
unknown_register.would_be_established_by: Register a p99 TTFT gate before the next arm from the intended customer SLO, then freeze it with the other gates. No source sets one.

unknown_register.requirement: Numeric SLA floor (monthly uptime percentage and credit schedule).
unknown_register.would_be_established_by: No source states a minimum. Establish from the intended buyer's outage cost: a floor needs the buyer's own downtime cost per hour and the shop's credit schedule, neither of which the estate has.

unknown_register.requirement: Recovery: detection, acknowledgement, repair, readiness, resumed useful work, rework, operator minutes after a controlled failure of a disposable job.
unknown_register.would_be_established_by: Run the section 5 drill on a disposable supervised process on each shortlisted shop, and record every timestamp named there. Fleet MTBF cannot be measured from one seat; it needs an agreed fleet sample from the operator (Cooperative host mode).

unknown_register.requirement: Egress and storage price transparency; no punitive egress or offboarding fees.
unknown_register.would_be_established_by: Read the egress and storage lines on the pricing page and one invoice for each shop.

unknown_register.requirement: Fresh tenant state on first login: no previous-tenant files, keys or history.
unknown_register.would_be_established_by: Run counter step 7 immediately after first SSH on each shop.

unknown_register.requirement: Default network exposure on first boot.
unknown_register.would_be_established_by: Run a first-boot port scan on each shop.
